abstract: InMotion shared hosting is fast for small sites, with a 90-day money-back guarantee on its own page. Launch renews at 4.0 times its sale price, and WooCommerce checkout was slower in tests.

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes for small and medium sites. Webhostingcat measured a 100% GTmetrix score, and SimonHosting measured 99.99% uptime.
Launch starts at $3.49 a month on the longest term and renews at $13.99. Power is $4.49 renewing at $17.99, and Pro is $8.49 renewing at $24.99.

mainEntity.name: Does InMotion have a money-back guarantee?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. InMotion's own page lists a 90-day money-back guarantee.
Webhostingcat measured a 135 ms time to first byte and a 333 ms Largest Contentful Paint on a Los Angeles shared plan.
For small stores, yes. Webhostingcat saw a 775 ms time to first byte at checkout, and advises a managed host for heavy traffic.
TechRadar says backups are not included on shared plans.

mainEntity.name: Does InMotion include a free domain?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Reviewers list a free domain for the first year and free SSL on shared plans.
We found no AI builder or assistant. The chat widget on its site is an AI bot.

mainEntity.name: How steep is the InMotion renewal price?

acceptedAnswer.text: Launch renews at $13.99 a month, 4.0 times the $3.49 sale price. Pro renews at 2.9 times.

mainEntity.name: Does InMotion have a Black Friday sale?

acceptedAnswer.text: Its homepage shows up to 70% off, valid through 1 December 2026, 12 p.m. ET.
InMotion has a longer money-back window. Hostinger has a lower entry price, a lower renewal and more AI tools.
Owners of busy stores, people who want AI tools and anyone who wants the lowest price for years.
